name: BIZcomfort Asakusa
card: A 24-hour coworking building two minutes from Asakusa Station, steps from Kaminarimon-dori
title: BIZcomfort Asakusa — 24-hour coworking 2 min from Asakusa Station, near Senso-ji
lead: Two minutes' walk from Asakusa Station on the Tsukuba Express, BIZcomfort Asakusa fills floors 1 to 7 of the Imon Asakusa Sushiya-dori Building in Taito City, a short walk from Kaminarimon. Members can use it 24 hours a day, every day. Drop-in costs ¥440 an hour or ¥1,650 a day on weekdays 9:00–18:00, with no registration (the official site currently shows drop-in as paused, so check before you go). Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 2 min walk from Asakusa Station (Tsukuba Express) / 5 min from Tawaramachi Station (Ginza Line) / 6 min from Asakusa Station (Ginza Line, Tobu Line, Toei Asakusa Line)
Members 24 hours, every day / drop-in weekdays 9:00–18:00
63 free-seating desks, 8 semi-private booths, 42 private offices
concept: A renovated building that tells Asakusa's story of change
BIZcomfort renovated a whole building two minutes from the station and says the design expresses the transitions in Asakusa's history.
Booths are split by use: café booths where you can eat, talk and take online meetings, work booths where calls are limited to 10 minutes, and silent booths for focused work.
steps: Café booths allow food, calls and online meetings; work booths allow calls of up to 10 minutes; silent booths allow no talking or calls.
The entrance is on Sushiya-dori. A concierge offers optional services.
Rows of partitioned desks for focused work.

word.title: What is drop-in?
body: Using a coworking space for the day without becoming a member.
At BIZcomfort Asakusa, drop-in is ¥440 an hour or ¥1,650 a day with no advance registration. Seats cannot be booked.

name: BIZcomfort Sanjo Kiyamachi
card: Top-floor coworking with views over Kyoto, 3 minutes from Sanjo Station by the Kamo River
title: BIZcomfort Sanjo Kiyamachi — top-floor 24-hour coworking 3 min from Sanjo, Kyoto
lead: Three minutes' walk from Sanjo Station on the Keihan Line, BIZcomfort Sanjo Kiyamachi is on the 5th, 9th and 10th floors of aune Kyoto Sanjo in Nakagyo Ward, beside the Kamo River and Sanjo Ohashi bridge. The coworking floors sit at the top of the building with panoramic views over the city, and members can use them 24 hours a day, every day. There is no hourly drop-in; the pay-as-you-go 1-minute plan costs ¥6.6 a minute after a ¥5,500 registration. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 3 min walk from Sanjo Station (Keihan) and Sanjo Keihan Station (Tozai Line) / 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Station / 8 min from Kyoto-kawaramachi Station (Hankyu)
1-minute plan ¥6.6 per minute (registration fee ¥5,500) / Kyoto plan ¥14,300/month
61 free-seating desks, 36 semi-private booths, 32 private offices
concept: Views over Kyoto from the top floor
The official site says the space is on the top floor of the building, with a panoramic view across the city.
Coworking is spread over two floors, with a meeting room fitted with a large screen and private rooms for online meetings.
steps: Café booths allow food, calls and online meetings; work booths allow calls of up to 10 minutes.
There are 32 lockable private offices for one to six people.

word.title: What is the 1-minute plan?
body: A plan where you pay only for the time you use, by the minute.
After registering, BIZcomfort's 1-minute plan works at any BIZcomfort coworking space in Japan.
